en.title: All investment opportunities
en.text:
- Affordable Housing in Masaka & Mayembe (Real Estate): Land available in Masaka City and Mayembe Gambogo for affordable housing schemes and mixed-use development.
- BBS Content Company (Media): Investment opportunity in content development through BBS TV, a platform to drive cultural media and storytelling.
- County Centre Redevelopment (Trade & Commerce): Modernize county centres with retail, markets, and commercial real estate investments across Buganda.
- Cultural Village at Kabaka’s Lake (Tourism, 10 acres): 10 acres available for the creation of a cultural village showcasing Buganda’s heritage and traditions.
- Dormitory and Hostel Investment (Education): Invest in dormitories and hostels to support future educational infrastructure and youth development programs.
- Granite & Mineral Deposits (Trade & Commerce): Buganda holds untapped rock deposits with granite and other valuable minerals in the Kyagwe region.
- Jeza Agriculture Land (Agriculture, 402 acres): 402 acres of fertile land in Jeza ready for commercial farming, agribusiness, or agro-industrial ventures.
- K2 Fintech Innovation (Media): K2 is open for strategic partnerships in fintech and digital content innovation within Buganda’s media ecosystem.
- Kabaka’s Lake Tourism Project (Tourism): Opportunity to invest in the redevelopment of Kabaka’s Lake as a heritage and tourism attraction.
- Lubiri Redevelopment Plan (Real Estate, 110 acres): 110 acres at Lubiri designated for an education complex, teaching hospital, exhibition grounds, and a new palace.
- Lubiri Teaching Hospital Site (Health, 80 acres): 80 acres within Lubiri are available for establishing a state-of-the-art teaching hospital in central Uganda.
- Masaka Agricultural Campus (Agriculture, 100 acres): 100 acres part of Masaka campus open for mixed-use agriculture or agri-education hub development.
- Mutundwe Hill Development (Real Estate, 36 acres): 36 acres on Mutundwe Hill ideal for residential and commercial real estate development.
- Mwanyi Terimba Agro-commerce (Trade & Commerce, Agriculture): Invest in Mwanyi Terimba Ltd—Buganda’s agro-commercial initiative focused on coffee and local produce value chains.
- Platform Commerce with Jumia (Trade & Commerce): Explore partnership opportunities under Buganda’s Jumia-powered digital trade initiative promoting local products.
- Rakai Mega Farm (Agriculture, 500 acres): 500 acres in Rakai suited for commercial farming, outgrower schemes, or agro-processing initiatives.
- Ssesse Island Farmland (Agriculture, 200 acres): 200 acres available in Ssesse, ideal for large-scale crop or animal farming projects with eco-tourism potential.
- Villas and Apartments for Sale (Real Estate): High-end villas, apartments, and bungalows available for purchase in Kigo and Sentema – great for real estate investors.
- Women and Children Hospital – Wakiso (Health, 15 acres): 15 acres in Wakiso Town Council earmarked for a specialized hospital for women and children—open for healthcare partnerships.
- Youth Training Centre Development (Education, 25 acres): 25 acres along Entebbe Road are available for establishing a youth-focused training centre (Ekisaakaate), with potential for skills development and cultural education.

lg.title: Emikisa gyonna egy'okusiga ensimbi
lg.text:
- Amayumba Agasoboka mu Bbeeyi e Masaka ne Mayembe (Amayumba n'ettaka): Ettaka liriwo mu Kibuga Masaka ne Mayembe Gambogo ery'enteekateeka z'amayumba agasoboka mu bbeeyi n'enkulaakulana ey'emirimu egy'enjawulo.
- BBS Content Company (Ebyamawulire): Omukisa gw'okusiga ensimbi mu kukola ebiweerezebwa ku mpewo nga biyita ku BBS TV, omukutu ogutumbula eby'empuliziganya eby'obuwangwa n'okunyumya engero.
- Okuzimba Obuggya Ebitebe by'Amasaza (Eby'obusuubuzi): Okufuula ebitebe by'amasaza eby'omulembe nga tussaayo amaduuka, obutale, n'ebizimbe eby'obusuubuzi mu Buganda yonna.
- Ekyalo ky'Obuwangwa ku Nnyanja ya Kabaka (Eby'obulambuzi, 10 yiika): Yiika 10 ziriwo okuzimbako ekyalo ky'obuwangwa ekyolesa obusika n'ennono za Buganda.
- Okusiga Ensimbi mu Bisulo by'Abayizi n'Amayumba g'Abayizi (Hostels) (Ebyenjigiriza): Siga ensimbi mu bisulo n'amayumba g'abayizi okuwagira ebizimbe by'ebyenjigiriza eby'omu maaso n'enteekateeka z'enkulaakulana y'abavubuka.
- Amayinja ga Granite n'Ebyobugagga eby'Omu Ttaka (Eby'obusuubuzi): Buganda erina amayinja agatannaba kukozesebwa, omuli granite n'ebyobugagga ebirala eby'omuwendo eby'omu ttaka, mu kitundu ky'e Kyaggwe.
- Ettaka ly'Ebyobulimi e Jeza (Ebyobulimi, 402 yiika): Yiika 402 ez'ettaka eggimu e Jeza nga lyetegefu okulimirwako ku mutendera gw'obusuubuzi, emirimu gy'obusuubuzi bw'ebyobulimi, oba amakolero ag'ebyobulimi.
- Obuyiiya bwa K2 mu Tekinologiya w'Ensimbi (Fintech) (Ebyamawulire): K2 eggulawo emikago egy'enkizo mu tekinologiya w'ensimbi (fintech) n'obuyiiya mu biweerezebwa ebya digito munda mu mukutu gw'ebyamawulire ogwa Buganda.
- Pulojekiti y'Obulambuzi ku Nnyanja ya Kabaka (Eby'obulambuzi): Omukisa gw'okusiga ensimbi mu kuzza obuggya Ennyanja ya Kabaka ng'ekifo eky'obusika era eky'obulambuzi.
- Enteekateeka y'Okuzimba Obuggya Olubiri (Amayumba n'ettaka, 110 yiika): Yiika 110 mu Lubiri ezaawuliddwa ku lw'ekifo ky'ebyenjigiriza, eddwaliro ly'okusomesezaamu, ekifo eky'emyoleso, n'olubiri olupya.
- Ekifo ky'Eddwaliro ly'Okusomesezaamu mu Lubiri (Ebyobulamu, 80 yiika): Yiika 80 munda mu Lubiri ziriwo okuzimbako eddwaliro ly'okusomesezaamu ery'omulembe mu masekkati ga Uganda.
- Ekifo ky'Ebyobulimi e Masaka (Ebyobulimi, 100 yiika): Yiika 100 ezitundu ku kifo ky'e Masaka ziggule okukozesebwa mu byobulimi eby'enjawulo oba okuzimba ekifo eky'okusomesezaamu ebyobulimi.
- Enkulaakulana ku Lusozi Mutundwe (Amayumba n'ettaka, 36 yiika): Yiika 36 ku Lusozi Mutundwe ezisaanira ennyo okuzimbako amayumba ag'okusulamu n'ebizimbe eby'obusuubuzi.
- Obusuubuzi bw'Ebyobulimi bwa Mwanyi Terimba (Eby'obusuubuzi, Ebyobulimi): Siga ensimbi mu Mwanyi Terimba Ltd — enteekateeka ya Buganda ey'obusuubuzi bw'ebyobulimi essa essira ku mmwanyi n'emitendera gy'ebirime eby'omu kitundu okuva mu nnimiro okutuuka ku katale.
- Obusuubuzi ku Mukutu gwa Jumia (Eby'obusuubuzi): Noonyereza ku mikisa gy'emikago wansi w'enteekateeka ya Buganda ey'obusuubuzi obwa digito ekozesa Jumia, etumbula ebintu ebikolebwa mu kitundu.
- Faamu Ennene ey'e Rakai (Ebyobulimi, 500 yiika): Yiika 500 e Rakai ezisaanira okulimirwako ku mutendera gw'obusuubuzi, enteekateeka z'abalimi abakolagana ne faamu (outgrower schemes), oba okukola ku birime mu makolero.
- Ettaka ly'Ebyobulimi ku Bizinga by'e Ssese (Ebyobulimi, 200 yiika): Yiika 200 ziriwo e Ssese, nga zisaanira nnyo pulojekiti ennene ez'okulima ebirime oba okulunda ensolo, era nga zirina omukisa gw'obulambuzi bw'obutonde.
- Villa n'Amayumba ag'Emiwaatwa (Apartments) Agatundibwa (Amayumba n'ettaka): Villa ez'omutindo ogwa waggulu, amayumba ag'emiwaatwa, n'amayumba ag'omu kalina emu (bungalows) bitundibwa e Kigo ne Sentema – birungi nnyo eri abasizi b'ensimbi mu by'amayumba n'ettaka.
- Eddwaliro ly'Abakazi n'Abaana – Wakiso (Ebyobulamu, 15 yiika): Yiika 15 mu Wakiso Town Council ezaawuliddwa ku lw'eddwaliro ery'enjawulo ery'abakazi n'abaana — enkolagana mu by'obulamu zaanirizibwa.
- Okuzimba Ekifo ky'Okutendekeramu Abavubuka (Ebyenjigiriza, 25 yiika): Yiika 25 ku luguudo lw'e Entebbe ziriwo okuzimbako ekifo ky'okutendekeramu abavubuka (Ekisaakaate), nga kirina omukisa gw'okukulaakulanya obukugu n'okusomesa obuwangwa.

en.title: About Us
en.text:
Buganda Investment and Commercial Undertaking Ltd (BICUL) is the official investment arm of the Buganda Kingdom, committed to building value through land-based investment, partnerships, innovation, and economic empowerment of our people.
Buganda Investments and Commercial Undertakings Limited (BICUL) aims at generating revenue from engagement in viable appropriate investment and commercial undertakings for financing or co-financing of Buganda’s economic, social and cultural developmental programs.
BICUL takes up its core role of a holding company of the Kingdom that own stake in various companies involved in production of goods & services and preservation of culture for the benefit of the Kingdom.
Vision: Innovate, empower and create prosperity for Buganda Kingdom.
Mission: To create Value from the Kingdom’s vast resources.
Motto: Buganda Kuntiko
Triple Bottom Lines: Our triple bottom lines approach ensures sustainable development while preserving our cultural heritage and promoting the wellbeing of our people.
- Preserve, Promote and Develop Cultural Heritage: We safeguard, advance, and grow our rich cultural heritage for future generations.
- Transformation of the livelihood of the people: We empower our communities, fostering improved livelihoods and brighter futures for all.
- Sustainable Existence of the Kingdom: We ensure the long-term vitality and enduring legacy of our kingdom.

lg.title: Ebitukwatako
lg.text:
Buganda Investment and Commercial Undertaking Ltd (BICUL) kye kitongole ky'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ekivunaanyizibwa ku kusiga ensimbi, ekyewaayo okuzimba omugaso nga kiyita mu kusiga ensimbi mu ttaka, mu mikago, mu buyiiya, n'okuwa abantu baffe amaanyi mu by'enfuna.
Buganda Investments and Commercial Undertakings Limited (BICUL) egenderera okufuna ensimbi nga eyita mu kwenyigira mu kusiga ensimbi okusaanidde era okw'omuganyulo n'emirimu gy'obusuubuzi, okusobola okuwa ensimbi oba okugattako ku nsimbi z'enteekateeka za Buganda ez'enkulaakulana mu by'enfuna, mu by'embeera z'abantu, ne mu buwangwa.
BICUL ekola omulimu gwayo omukulu ng'ekitongole ky'Obwakabaka ekirina emigabo (holding company) mu kampuni ez'enjawulo ezikola ebintu n'okuwa obuweereza, n'okukuuma obuwangwa, ku lw'omuganyulo gw'Obwakabaka.
Ekirooto: Okuyiiya, okuwa amaanyi n'okuleeta obugagga eri Obwakabaka bwa Buganda.
Ekigendererwa: Okuggya omugaso mu by'obugagga by'Obwakabaka ebingi ennyo.
Omulamwa: Buganda Kuntiko
Emisingi Esatu egy'Enkulaakulana: Enkola yaffe ey'emisingi esatu ekakasa enkulaakulana ey'olubeerera nga bwe tukuuma obuwangwa bwaffe n'okutumbula embeera z'abantu baffe.
- Okukuuma, Okutumbula n'Okukulaakulanya Obuwangwa: Tukuuma, tutumbula, era tukuza obuwangwa bwaffe obw'omuwendo ku lw'emirembe egijja.
- Okukyusa embeera z'obulamu bw'abantu: Tuwa ebitundu byaffe amaanyi, nga tukulaakulanya embeera z'obulamu era nga tutegeka ebiseera eby'omu maaso ebirungi eri buli muntu.
- Obuwangaazi bw'Obwakabaka obw'Olubeerera: Tukakasa nti Obwakabaka bwaffe bubeera n'amaanyi okumala ebbanga eddene era nti obusika bwabwo bubeerawo emirembe gyonna.

en.title: Why Invest in Buganda?
en.text:
The Kingdom of Buganda is the largest traditional Kingdom in present day Uganda, comprising Uganda’s entire Central region including the capital Kampala with the present population of about 10 million people. The Kingdom’s strategic central location is a home of a hive of malleable enterprises, aiding strong commanding investment venture.
One may wonder, why Buganda
- 70% of business sales or goods and services happen within a radius of 50- 80kms from which is all Buganda.
- The passion, love and loyalty of the people of Buganda for their King and Kingdom are in their DNA. You will have guaranteed access to this segment of the market.
- The current Kingdom administration is dynamic, empowered engaged and extremely professional
- Buganda Kingdom has a lot of land constituted with water, forests and special stones among others
- Some pieces of land are in the capital city and urban centers (very prime for high end developments); while the rural areas have big chunks of suitable land for commercial farming.
With the existence of sound macroeconomic policies and a largely attractive investment climate, one is assured of maximizing a decent return on investment more so when they consider partnering with a credible institution that we are.
We welcome you to consider doing business with us.
Roland Michael Sebuwufu – Chief Executive Officer – sebuwufu@bicul.co.ug

lg.title: Lwaki Osiga Ensimbi mu Buganda?
lg.text:
Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwe bwakabaka obw'ennono obusinga obunene mu Uganda ey'ennaku zino, nga butwaliramu ekitundu kya Uganda kyonna eky'Amasekkati, omuli n'ekibuga ekikulu Kampala, era nga kirimu abantu nga obukadde 10. Ekifo eky'enkizo eky'Obwakabaka wakati mu ggwanga kiyumba emirimu mingi egyekyusa okusinziira ku mbeera, ekiyamba okusiga ensimbi okw'amaanyi.
Oyinza okwebuuza nti, lwaki Buganda
- 70% ku by'obusuubuzi, oba ebyamaguzi n'obuweereza, bikolebwa mu bbanga lya kiromita 50–80 okwetooloola, era ekitundu ekyo kyonna kiri mu Buganda.
- Obunyiikivu, okwagala n'obwesigwa bw'abantu ba Buganda eri Kabaka waabwe n'Obwakabaka biri mu musaayi gwabwe. Ojja kufuna omukisa ogukakasiddwa okutuuka ku kitundu kino eky'akatale.
- Obukulembeze bw'Obwakabaka obuliwo kati bukola nnyo, bulina obuyinza, bwenyigira mu mirimu, era bukozesa obukugu obw'amaanyi
- Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bulina ettaka lingi eririmu amazzi, ebibira n'amayinja ag'enjawulo, n'ebirala
- Ettaka erimu liri mu kibuga ekikulu ne mu bibuga ebirala (ery'omuwendo ennyo ku pulojekiti ez'omutindo ogwa waggulu); so nga mu byalo mulimu ettaka eddene erisaanira okulimirako ku mutendera gw'obusuubuzi.
Olw'okubaawo kw'enkola ennungi ez'eby'enfuna ez'eggwanga n'embeera ennungi ennyo ey'okusiga ensimbi, okakasa okufuna amagoba amalungi ku nsimbi z'osiga, naddala bw'osalawo okukolagana n'ekitongole ekyesigika nga ffe.
Tukwaniriza okulowooza ku kukola emirimu gy'obusuubuzi naffe.
Roland Michael Sebuwufu – Ssenkulu – sebuwufu@bicul.co.ug

en.title: Statistics Division
en.text:

The need for statistical information is recognized as an important and indispensable ingredient of all development programs.
The Statistics Division is governed by appointed board members composed of three eminent Statisticians and three officials from the Kingdom Government:

There is great optimism that with continued support from the Government of Uganda, the donor community, NGOs, and other stakeholders, the Buganda Statistics Division will fully realize its mission.
The Buganda Statistics Unit sincerely thanks all Ministries, Departments, Agencies, and individuals it collaborates with. BSU deeply appreciates their consistent support, cooperation, and encouragement.

lg.title: Ekitongole ky'Ebibalo
lg.text:
Ekitongole ky'Ebibalo gwe mpagi ey'enkola ennywevu ey'ebibalo n'okusalawo mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda.
Obwetaavu bw'ebibalo bumanyiddwa ng'ekintu ekikulu ennyo era ekyetaagisa mu nteekateeka zonna ez'enkulaakulana.
Ekitongole ky'Ebibalo kifugibwa olukiiko lw'abantu abalondeddwa, omuli abakugu mu bibalo basatu ab'erinnya n'abakungu basatu okuva mu Gavumenti y'Obwakabaka:
Etteeka erilung'amya emirimu gy'ebibalo mu Uganda lye Tteeka lya Uganda Bureau of Statistics (Juuni 1998). Etteeka lino lilaga enzimba y'Enkola y'Ebibalo ey'Eggwanga (NSS) n'emirimu gy'abeetabamu ab'enjawulo
Uganda Bureau of Statistics (UBOS) yalonda Mw. James Muwonge, Akulira Ekitongole ky'Obuweereza bw'Abakugu (Professional Services Unit), okubeera Omukungu omutongole akwasaganya, okuwagira n'okulung'amya Ekitongole kya Buganda eky'Ebibalo.
Waliwo essuubi lingi nti nga Gavumenti ya Uganda, abagabi b'obuyambi, ebitongole ebitali bya gavumenti (NGOs), n'abalala abakwatibwako beeyongera okuwagira, Ekitongole kya Buganda eky'Ebibalo kijja kutuukiriza ekigendererwa kyakyo mu bujjuvu.
Ekitongole kya Buganda eky'Ebibalo kyebaza nnyo Minisitule zonna, Ebitongole, Ebiwayi, n'abantu kinnoomu b'ekikolagana nabo. BSU esiima nnyo obuwagizi bwabwe obutakyuka, okukolagana, n'okuzzibwamu amaanyi.
Ekirooto: Buganda ejja kubeera nnakola era nnakozesa w'ebibalo ow'omutindo ogwa waggulu.

en.title: Strategic Partnerships Division
en.text:
The strategic Partnerships unit was established as department within the Buganda Investment and Commercial Undertaking Limited (BICUL) to attract development partners that are not for profit engagement.
The SPU’s main focus is to research appropriate partnerships and grant opportunities from, private trusts, philanthropic foundations, NGOs and relevant government agencies. The unit seeks to identify and interest donor agencies, creating alliances and inspiring supporters that are willing and seeking to provide funds in form of grants and donations as well as alliances to help Buganda to improve and deliver services to the people at the grass root across all service sectors. In contribution to the strategic plan, the SPU aims at mainly “Creating Wealth and improving the welfare of people living in Buganda. The SPU works in coordination with all Buganda Ministries as delivery channels to service delivery.
Vision: To strategically position the Kingdom of Buganda as a key implementation partner in service delivery by the year 2020
Mission: To oversee grant activity in the Kingdom that includes identification and notification of relevant funding opportunities in a timely manner, coordinating requirements and providing budget, contract management, programmatic and research assistance during grant application process, monitoring and ensuring regulatory compliance of grants awarded.
- Present and broadcast the Kingdom of Buganda and its structures to the donor community.
- Source for funds to support the various projects and Ministries that will improve the livelihood of people in the Kingdom of Buganda.
- To create and maintain strategic partnerships with major development agencies.
- To contribute towards the financial and Institutional sustainability of the Kingdom of Buganda.
- To ensure accountability and project delivery for all funds received.

lg.title: Ekitongole ky'Enkolagana ez'Enkizo
lg.text:
Ekitongole ky'Enkolagana ez'Enkizo kyatandikibwawo ng'ekitongole munda mu Buganda Investment and Commercial Undertaking Limited (BICUL) okusikiriza bannamukago mu by'enkulaakulana abatakola lwa magoba.
Ekigendererwa ekikulu ekya SPU kwe kunoonyereza ku mikago egisaanidde n'emikisa gy'ensimbi ez'obuyambi okuva mu bwesige obw'obwannannyini (private trusts), ebibiina by'obuyambi, ebitongole ebitali bya gavumenti (NGOs) n'ebitongole bya gavumenti ebikwatibwako. Ekitongole kino kinoonya era kisikiriza ebitongole ebigaba obuyambi, nga kizimba emikago era nga kizzaamu amaanyi abawagizi abeetegefu era abanoonya okuwaayo ensimbi mu ngeri y'obuyambi n'ebirabo, awamu n'emikago, okuyamba Buganda okulongoosa n'okutuusa obuweereza ku bantu ab'emitendera egya wansi mu bitundu byonna eby'obuweereza. Mu kuyamba ku nteekateeka enkulu ey'enkulaakulana, SPU egenderera okusinga ennyo “Okutondawo Obugagga n'okulongoosa embeera z'abantu abawangaala mu Buganda. SPU ekolagana ne Minisitule zonna eza Buganda ng'emikutu gy'okutuusa obuweereza.
Ekirooto: Okuteeka Obwakabaka bwa Buganda mu kifo eky'enkizo ng'omunnamukago omukulu mu kuteeka mu nkola obuweereza, okutuuka mu mwaka 2020
Ekigendererwa: Okulabirira emirimu gy'ensimbi ez'obuyambi mu Bwakabaka, omuli okuzuula n'okutegeeza ku mikisa gy'ensimbi egikwatagana mu budde, okukwasaganya ebyetaagisa n'okuwa obuyambi mu kukola embalirira, okuddukanya endagaano, enteekateeka, n'okunoonyereza mu kiseera ky'okusaba ensimbi ez'obuyambi, okulondoola n'okukakasa nti amateeka gagobererwa ku nsimbi ez'obuyambi eziweereddwa.
- Okwanjula n'okulanga Obwakabaka bwa Buganda n'enzimba yaabwo eri abagabi b'obuyambi.
- Okunoonya ensimbi okuwagira pulojekiti ez'enjawulo ne Minisitule ezijja okulongoosa embeera z'abantu mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda.
- Okutondawo n'okukuuma emikago egy'enkizo n'ebitongole ebinene eby'enkulaakulana.
- Okuyamba ku buwangaazi bw'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda mu by'ensimbi ne mu bitongole byabwo.
- Okukakasa obuvunaanyizibwa n'okutuukiriza pulojekiti ku nsimbi zonna eziweebwa.

en.title: Incubation Division
en.text:
The Incubation Division is the department holding the fort within Buganda Investments and Commercial Undertaking Limited (BICUL) to incubate ideas and initiatives that are designed to boost the Kingdom’s investment portfolio and equity.
The Incubation Division’s focus is to mainstream engagement in viable appropriate investment and commercial undertakings for financing and/or co-financing of Buganda’s economic, social and cultural development programs. It is an ideation unit which focuses on initiating and receiving, processing and monitoring the implementation of the projects approved by the Kingdom’s Executive structures.
The Division seeks to identify and interest potential investors on the available investment opportunities in pursuit and development of risky business opportunities as we contribute to the achievement of the Kingdom’s Strategic Plan. In coordination with all Buganda ministries and institutions to achieve our mission, the Incubation division is the Kingdom’s platform that tries out new things, offering the ability to face the unknown, to experiment with new ideas, and act with great openness and flexibility.
Vision: To strategically position the Kingdom of Buganda as a key investment partner which focuses on achievement of inclusive sustainable development as it pursues its commitment to take Buganda to the helm.
Mission: To increase the successful development of new businesses and initiatives, job creation and employment in specific sectors that are aligned with the Kingdom’s unique areas of opportunity.
- Preparing and presenting different investment opportunities available in the Kingdom of Buganda to the potential local and international investors.
- Engaging in the creation of innovative and sustainable start-up companies/support their growth and development.
- Developing and implementing new initiatives for incubation service offerings to potential investment partners and Kingdom companies. Developing new ideas into viable businesses.
- Developing and leveraging the Kingdom’s brand for the benefit of the people of Buganda.
- Assisting the Kingdom Institutions in proposal writing, pitch deck, business development, fundraising as well as relevant linkages to established companies for business opportunities.
- Fostering the entrepreneurial mindset in the Kingdom institutions to drive innovation capabilities.
Contact: Daniel Nakibinge, Principal Investments and Planning Officer, nakibinge@bicul.co.ug

lg.title: Ekitongole ky'Okukuza Emirimu Emipya
lg.text:
Ekitongole ky'Okukuza Emirimu Emipya kye kitongole ekikulembera munda mu Buganda Investments and Commercial Undertaking Limited (BICUL) mu kukuza ebirowoozo n'enteekateeka ebigendereddwamu okwongera ku mirimu n'emigabo Obwakabaka gye bwasigamu ensimbi.
Ekitongole ky'Okukuza Emirimu Emipya kissa essira ku kunywereza okwenyigira mu kusiga ensimbi okusaanidde era okw'omuganyulo n'emirimu gy'obusuubuzi, okusobola okuwa ensimbi oba okugattako ku nsimbi z'enteekateeka za Buganda ez'enkulaakulana mu by'enfuna, mu by'embeera z'abantu, ne mu buwangwa. Kitongole ekiyiiya ebirowoozo, ekissa essira ku kutandikawo, okufuna, okukola ku, n'okulondoola okuteeka mu nkola pulojekiti eziba zikkiriziddwa enzimba y'Obukulembeze bw'Obwakabaka.
Ekitongole kinoonya era kisikiriza abasizi b'ensimbi abayinza okujja ku mikisa gy'okusiga ensimbi egiriwo, mu kunoonya n'okukulaakulanya emikisa gy'obusuubuzi egirimu akabi, nga bwe tuyamba okutuukiriza Enteekateeka Enkulu ey'Obwakabaka. Nga kikolagana ne minisitule n'ebitongole bya Buganda byonna okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kyaffe, ekitongole kino gwe mukutu gw'Obwakabaka ogugezesa ebintu ebipya, ogusobozesa okwolekera ebitamanyiddwa, okugezesa ebirowoozo ebipya, n'okukola n'obugumiikiriza n'obwangu bungi.
Ekirooto: Okuteeka Obwakabaka bwa Buganda mu kifo eky'enkizo ng'omunnamukago omukulu mu kusiga ensimbi, ng'essira liri ku kutuuka ku nkulaakulana ey'olubeerera etwaliramu buli muntu, nga bwe butuukiriza obweyamo bwabwo obw'okutwala Buganda ku ntikko.
Ekigendererwa: Okwongera ku buwanguzi mu kutandikawo emirimu n'enteekateeka empya, okutondawo emirimu n'okuwa abantu emirimu mu bitundu ebikwatagana n'emikisa egy'enjawulo Obwakabaka gye bulina.
- Okutegeka n'okwanjula emikisa egy'enjawulo egy'okusiga ensimbi egiri mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda eri abasizi b'ensimbi ab'omunda mu ggwanga n'ab'ebweru abayinza okujja.
- Okwenyigira mu kutandikawo kampuni empya ez'obuyiiya era ez'olubeerera n'okuwagira okukula n'okukulaakulana kwazo.
- Okukola n'okuteeka mu nkola enteekateeka empya ez'obuweereza bw'okukuza emirimu eri bannamukago abayinza okusiga ensimbi ne kampuni z'Obwakabaka. Okufuula ebirowoozo ebipya emirimu egy'omuganyulo.
- Okukulaakulanya n'okukozesa erinnya ly'Obwakabaka ku lw'omuganyulo gw'abantu ba Buganda.
- Okuyamba Ebitongole by'Obwakabaka mu kuwandiika ebiteeso, okutegeka ebyanjulo by'emirimu (pitch deck), okukulaakulanya emirimu, okusonda ensimbi, awamu n'okubakwasaganya ne kampuni ezinywevu olw'emikisa gy'obusuubuzi.
- Okutumbula endowooza y'obwannannyini mu mirimu mu bitongole by'Obwakabaka okusobola okwongera ku busobozi bw'obuyiiya.
Tuukirira: Daniel Nakibinge, Omukungu Omukulu ow'Okusiga Ensimbi n'Enteekateeka, nakibinge@bicul.co.ug

en.title: Monitoring and Evaluation
en.text:
The Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) Office was established under the Partnerships Department within Buganda Investments and Commercial Undertakings Ltd.
Its core mandate is to ensure that all obligations and commitments outlined in the Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) signed between the Buganda Kingdom and her partners are fully implemented and monitored for impact.
This office plays a critical role in fostering mutually beneficial relationships by ensuring that both the Kingdom and her partners derive tangible value from their collaboration.
The Kingdom leverages these partnerships to deliver essential services and development programs to her people, advancing key sectors such as education, health, agriculture, environment, and youth empowerment. Meanwhile, partners benefit from increased visibility, enhanced brand reputation, and positive public relations, as they are seen contributing to meaningful community development initiatives within the Kingdom.
By tracking outcomes and evaluating progress, the M&E Office ensures accountability, learning, and continuous improvements so that the fruits of partnership are not only realized but also sustained for long-term impact.

lg.title: Okulondoola n'Okwekenneenya
lg.text:
Ofiisi y'Okulondoola n'Okwekenneenya (M&E) yatandikibwawo wansi w'Ekitongole ky'Emikago mu Buganda Investments and Commercial Undertakings Ltd.
Omulimu gwayo omukulu kwe kukakasa nti obuvunaanyizibwa bwonna n'obweyamo obuli mu Ndagaano z'Okukwatagana (MOUs) ezissibwako emikono wakati w'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ne bannamukago babwo biteekebwa mu nkola mu bujjuvu era ne bilondoolebwa okulaba ebivaamu.
Ofiisi eno ekola omulimu omukulu ennyo mu kutumbula enkolagana ey'omuganyulo eri enjuyi zombi, nga ekakasa nti Obwakabaka ne bannamukago babwo bombi bafuna omugaso ogulabika okuva mu nkolagana yaabwe.
Obwakabaka bukozesa emikago gino okutuusa obuweereza obwetaagisa n'enteekateeka z'enkulaakulana eri abantu babwo, nga butumbula ebitundu ebikulu nga ebyenjigiriza, ebyobulamu, ebyobulimi, obutonde bw'ensi, n'okuwa abavubuka amaanyi. Ate bannamukago bo bagasibwa nga beeyongera okumanyibwa, erinnya lyabwe ne lyeyongera okwesigibwa, n'okulabika obulungi mu bantu, kubanga balabibwa nga bayamba ku nteekateeka ez'amakulu ez'enkulaakulana y'ebitundu munda mu Bwakabaka.
Nga erondoola ebivaamu n'okwekenneenya enkulaakulana, Ofiisi ya M&E ekakasa obuvunaanyizibwa, okuyiga, n'okweyongera okulongoosa, ebibala by'emikago bireme kutuukirira kyokka wabula n'okuwangaala okumala ebbanga eddene.

en.title: Social Impact Collaborations
en.text:
Driving Transformation in the Kingdom of Buganda Through Strategic Partnerships
Welcome to a special feature highlighting the Kingdom of Buganda’s growing network of social impact collaborations—where tradition meets modern innovation to create meaningful change.
Inspired by our development agenda, “Buganda ku Ntikko” (Buganda at the Helm), we continue to work hand-in-hand with partners from across the globe to design and implement initiatives that uplift communities, preserve culture, and foster inclusive progress.
Our focus spans across six transformative pillars: Agriculture, Education, Health, Gender Empowerment, Youth Empowerment, Environment
Agriculture: Nutrition & Income Generation
Buganda Kingdom launched the Mwanyi Terimba campaign to combat poverty and empower communities through coffee farming. The campaign has transformed livelihoods, increased household incomes, and strengthened the Kingdom’s agricultural economy.
👥 In partnership with local farmers and stakeholders, Mwanyi Terimba continues to inspire a new generation of agri-preneurs.
Education: Access & Affordability for All
Buganda has established a network of educational institutions—from nursery to university—offering quality, culturally grounded education.
Key institutions include:
- Lubiri Nnaabagereka Primary School
- Lubiri High School
- Buganda Royal Institute
- Muteesa I Royal University
- Bowa Vocational Secondary School
Through the Kabaka Education Fund, underprivileged students are supported with bursaries, while plans are underway to roll out Early Learning Centres at each county headquarters.
Health: Community-Centered Wellness
The Kingdom actively promotes health and wellness through:
- Health Camps
- Community Health Worker Programs
- Immunization Drives
- Public Health Education
These efforts, in partnership with government and NGOs, have helped expand access to care and health literacy across Buganda’s communities.
Youth Empowerment: Skills, Creativity & Opportunity
With partners like the Directorate of Industrial Training (DIT) and Uganda Communications Commission (UCC), over 1,500 youth have been trained in:
- Vocational skills
- ICT and digital innovation
- Creative arts and performing arts
Our annual youth festivals and the Ekisakaate cultural camp nurture leadership, identity, and purpose among young people.
Gender Empowerment: Women, Children & Disability Inclusion
Buganda champions gender equity through targeted events and programs:
- Women’s Symposiums with Nnaabagereka
- Dinner for the Disabled, promoting inclusion
- Advocacy and support for children, mothers, and persons with disabilities
These initiatives reinforce the Kingdom’s commitment to dignity and equal opportunity for all.
Environment: Conservation, WASH & Bulungi Bwansi
Buganda’s environmental programs are bold and community-driven. In partnership with WWF, NEMA, NFA, UBF, and others, we organize:
- Annual Environmental Week with 2M+ trees planted
- Bulungi Bwansi (community clean-up) activities
- WASH projects for clean water and hygiene
- Ekibira kya Kabaka – a flagship forest conservation campaign
- Wells of Life – providing safe water access
These initiatives promote environmental stewardship at both household and institutional levels.
Decent Living Campaign: A Home for Every Family
In collaboration with Habitat for Humanity, Buganda Kingdom’s Decent Living Campaign seeks to improve housing and sanitation conditions in underserved communities. The program supports the most vulnerable, ensuring every family lives with dignity, safety, and hope.
Ongoing Civic Engagement
Manya e Ssaza Lyo (Know Your County)
This campaign fosters community awareness, accountability, and grassroots involvement in development. Citizens are encouraged to participate, monitor progress, and contribute to their county’s advancement.
Join Us in Building a Better Buganda
From village centers to global forums, the Kingdom of Buganda is leading a new era of people-powered development. These collaborations continue to drive real results—uplifting lives, preserving heritage, and securing a brighter future.

lg.title: Enkolagana ez'Okukyusa Embeera z'Abantu
lg.text:
Okuleeta Enkyukakyuka mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda nga tuyita mu Mikago egy'Enkizo
Tukwaniriza ku nnyanjula ey'enjawulo eraga omukutu gw'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ogweyongera okukula ogw'enkolagana ezikyusa embeera z'abantu — ennono gy'esisinkanira obuyiiya obw'omulembe okuleeta enkyukakyuka ey'amakulu.
Nga tuzzibwamu amaanyi enteekateeka yaffe ey'enkulaakulana, “Buganda ku Ntikko”, tweyongera okukwatagana ne bannamukago okuva mu nsi yonna okutegeka n'okuteeka mu nkola enteekateeka ezisitula ebitundu, ezikuuma obuwangwa, era ezitumbula enkulaakulana etwaliramu buli muntu.
Essira lyaffe liri ku mpagi mukaaga ezireeta enkyukakyuka: Ebyobulimi, Ebyenjigiriza, Ebyobulamu, Okuwa Abakazi Amaanyi n'Obwenkanya, Okuwa Abavubuka Amaanyi, Obutonde bw'Ensi
Ebyobulimi: Endya Ennungi n'Okufuna Ensimbi
Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwatongoza kaweefube wa Mwanyi Terimba okulwanyisa obwavu n'okuwa ebitundu amaanyi nga biyita mu kulima emmwanyi. Kaweefube ono akyusizza obulamu bw'abantu, ayongedde ku nsimbi ez'amaka, era anywezezza eby'enfuna by'Obwakabaka eby'obulimi.
Nga tukolagana n'abalimi ab'omu kitundu n'abalala abakwatibwako, Mwanyi Terimba yeeyongera okuzzaamu amaanyi omulembe omupya ogw'abalimi abakola ebyobulimi ng'omulimu gw'obusuubuzi.
Ebyenjigiriza: Okutuukirirwa n'Okusasulika eri Buli Muntu
Buganda etandikiddewo omukutu gw'amasomero n'ebitongole by'ebyenjigiriza — okuva ku bya nassale okutuuka ku yunivasite — ebiwa obuyigirize obw'omutindo obwesigamye ku buwangwa.
Ebitongole ebikulu mulimu:
- Lubiri Nnaabagereka Primary School
- Lubiri High School
- Buganda Royal Institute
- Muteesa I Royal University
- Bowa Vocational Secondary School
Nga bayita mu Kabaka Education Fund, abayizi abatalina busobozi bayambibwa ne bbasale, ate enteekateeka ziri mu ggiya okutandikawo Ebifo eby'Okusomesa Abaana Abato ku buli kitebe ky'essaza.
Ebyobulamu: Obulamu Obulungi Obwesigamye ku Bantu b'Omu Kitundu
Obwakabaka butumbula nnyo eby'obulamu obulungi nga buyita mu:
- Enkambi z'Ebyobulamu
- Enteekateeka z'Abasawo b'Ebyalo
- Kaweefube w'Okugema Endwadde
- Okusomesa Abantu ku By'obulamu
Kaweefube zino, nga zikolebwa wamu ne gavumenti n'ebitongole ebitali bya gavumenti (NGOs), ziyambye okwongera ku butuukirivu bw'obujjanjabi n'okumanya ku by'obulamu mu bitundu bya Buganda.
Okuwa Abavubuka Amaanyi: Obukugu, Obuyiiya n'Emikisa
Nga tukolagana ne bannamukago nga Directorate of Industrial Training (DIT) ne Uganda Communications Commission (UCC), abavubuka abasoba mu 1,500 batendekeddwa mu:
- Obukugu mu mikono
- Tekinologiya w'ebyempuliziganya (ICT) n'obuyiiya obwa digito
- Eby'okwolesa n'ebyemikutu (creative arts) n'eby'okuzannya ku siteegi
Emizannyo gyaffe egy'abavubuka egya buli mwaka n'Ekisaakaate (enkambi y'obuwangwa) bizimba obukulembeze, ennono, n'ekigendererwa mu bavubuka.
Okuwa Abakazi Amaanyi: Abakazi, Abaana n'Okutwaliramu Abaliko Obulemu
Buganda ekulembera mu kutumbula obwenkanya wakati w'abakazi n'abasajja nga eyita mu mikolo n'enteekateeka ezigendereddwamu:
- Enkung'aana z'Abakazi ne Nnaabagereka
- Ekijjulo ky'Abaliko Obulemu, ekitumbula okutwaliramu buli muntu
- Okwogerera n'okuwagira abaana, bamaama, n'abantu abaliko obulemu
Enteekateeka zino zinyweza obweyamo bw'Obwakabaka eri ekitiibwa n'emikisa egyenkanankana eri buli muntu.
Obutonde bw'Ensi: Okukuuma, Amazzi Amayonjo n'Obuyonjo (WASH) ne Bulungi Bwansi
Enteekateeka za Buganda ez'obutonde bw'ensi za maanyi era zikulemberwa abantu b'omu bitundu. Nga tukolagana ne WWF, NEMA, NFA, UBF, n'abalala, tutegeka:
- Wiiki y'Obutonde bw'Ensi eya buli mwaka, ng'emiti egisoba mu bukadde 2 gisimbiddwa
- Emirimu gya Bulungi Bwansi (okuyonja ebitundu)
- Pulojekiti za WASH ez'amazzi amayonjo n'obuyonjo
- Ekibira kya Kabaka – kaweefube omukulu ow'okukuuma ebibira
- Wells of Life – okutuusa amazzi amayonjo ku bantu
Enteekateeka zino zitumbula okulabirira obutonde bw'ensi mu maka ne mu bitongole.
Kaweefube w'Obulamu Obweyagaza: Ennyumba eri Buli Maka
Nga bakolagana ne Habitat for Humanity, Kaweefube w'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ow'Obulamu Obweyagaza agenderera okulongoosa embeera z'amayumba n'obuyonjo mu bitundu ebitafuna buweereza bumala. Enteekateeka eno ewagira abasinga okubeera mu bwetaavu, nga ekakasa nti buli maka gabeera mu kitiibwa, mu bukuumi, era n'essuubi.
Okwenyigira kw'Abantu mu Nkulaakulana Okugenda Mu Maaso
Manya e Ssaza Lyo
Kaweefube ono atumbula okumanya mu bantu b'omu bitundu, obuvunaanyizibwa, n'okwenyigira kw'abantu ab'emitendera egya wansi mu nkulaakulana. Abantu bakubirizibwa okwenyigira, okulondoola enkulaakulana, n'okuyamba ku nkulaakulana y'essaza lyabwe.
Twegatteko mu Kuzimba Buganda Esinga Obulungi
Okuva ku byalo okutuuka ku nkung'aana z'ensi yonna, Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bukulembera omulembe omupya ogw'enkulaakulana ekulemberwa abantu. Enkolagana zino zeeyongera okuleeta ebivaamu ebya nnamaddala — nga zisitula obulamu, zikuuma obusika, era zikakasa ebiseera eby'omu maaso ebirungi.

en.title: Enkulakulana ya Buganda Program (EBP)
en.text:
The Enkulakulana ya Buganda Program (EBP) is a flagship economic development initiative that seeks to empower households in the Buganda region through entrepreneurship, cooperative development, and financial literacy. The program works in partnership with local governments, Buganda’s clan system, and faith-based organizations to identify vulnerable communities and offer them access to SACCOs, farming inputs, and enterprise training.
The program focuses on four pillars:
- Skills training & vocational support
- SACCO capital injections
- Agricultural productivity
- Local market development
Impact Goals:
- Reach 100,000+ households by 2030
- Increase household incomes by 60%
- Establish 500+ community-based cooperatives

lg.title: Enkulakulana ya Buganda Program (EBP)
lg.text:
Enkulakulana ya Buganda Program (EBP) ye nteekateeka enkulu ey'enkulaakulana y'eby'enfuna egenderera okuwa amaka amaanyi mu kitundu kya Buganda nga eyita mu bwannannyini bw'emirimu, okukulaakulanya obwegassi, n'okumanya okukozesa ensimbi. Enteekateeka eno ekolagana ne gavumenti z'ebitundu, enkola y'ebika bya Buganda, n'ebitongole by'eddiini okuzuula ebitundu ebiri mu bwetaavu n'okubiwa omukisa okutuuka ku SACCO, ebyokulimisa, n'okutendekebwa mu kuddukanya emirimu.
Enteekateeka eno essa essira ku mpagi nnya:
- Okutendeka mu bukugu n'okuwagira obukugu bw'emikono
- Okussa ensimbi mu SACCO okwongera ku ntandikwa yaazo
- Okwongera ku makungula g'ebyobulimi
- Okukulaakulanya obutale obw'omu kitundu
Ebiruubirirwa by'Ebivaamu:
- Okutuuka ku maka agasoba mu 100,000 okutuuka mu 2030
- Okwongera ku nsimbi z'amaka ebitundu 60%
- Okutandikawo obwegassi obusoba mu 500 obw'omu bitundu

en.title: Buganda Agro Parks
en.text:
Buganda Agro Parks are BICUL-led agricultural investment hubs established on Kingdom land to promote modern, mechanized, and sustainable agriculture. These parks are strategically located in fertile regions like Ssingo and Kyaggwe, and focus on value chains such as coffee, maize, soybeans, and horticulture.
BICUL partners with private investors, farmer cooperatives, and agribusinesses to deliver services like irrigation infrastructure, seed distribution, extension services, and on-site processing plants.
Impact Goals:
- Engage 5,000+ farmers
- Export-ready produce within 2 years
- Strengthen Kingdom food reserves and reduce post-harvest losses

lg.title: Buganda Agro Parks

Ebifo bino biri mu bitundu eggimu nga Ssingo ne Kyaggwe, era bissa essira ku mitendera gy'ebirime nga emmwanyi, kasooli, soya, n'ebibala n'enva endiirwa.
BICUL ekolagana n'abasizi b'ensimbi ab'obwannannyini, obwegassi bw'abalimi, n'emirimu gy'obusuubuzi bw'ebyobulimi okutuusa obuweereza nga ebizimbe eby'okufukirira, okugaba ensigo, abakugu abasomesa abalimi, n'amakolero ag'okukola ku birime agali mu kifo kyennyini.
Ebiruubirirwa by'Ebivaamu:

en.title: Mengo Craft & Culture Centre
en.text:
The Mengo Craft & Culture Centre is a cultural tourism initiative designed to showcase Buganda’s heritage through craftsmanship, storytelling, and immersive experiences. Located near Bulange Mengo, the Centre brings together local artisans, historians, and cultural performers to produce and sell high-quality handmade crafts, conduct workshops, and host cultural festivals.
BICUL’s role is to manage the Centre as a sustainable commercial venture while creating jobs for youth and artisans. The project also serves as a heritage preservation effort and a tourism income stream.
Impact Goals:
- Empower 300+ local artisans annually
- Attract 10,000+ local and foreign tourists per year
- Generate recurring revenue to support cultural institutions

lg.title: Mengo Craft & Culture Centre

Omulimu gwa BICUL kwe kuddukanya Ekifo kino ng'omulimu gw'obusuubuzi ogw'olubeerera, nga bw'etondawo emirimu eri abavubuka n'abakugu b'emikono. Pulojekiti eno era kaweefube wa kukuuma busika era mukutu gwa kufuna nsimbi okuva mu bulambuzi.

en.title: Nkuluze
en.text:
Nkuluze is referred to as the “Royal Treasury” responsible for taking care of the Kingship. It’s a huge organization within Buganda Kingdom, headed by the Royal Treasurer “Omuwanika w’Enkuluze” (Royal Treasurer). The Royal Treasurer or “Omuwanika w’Enkuluze” is appointed in this office by Ssaabasajja Kabaka and he is only accountable to him. After the 1966 crisis in Buganda, almost all initiatives, undertakings and offices were forcefully closed by the regime including Nkuluze because the King was no longer on the throne (Nnamulondo). However, after the liberation war of 1986, initiatives to reestablish the Kingdom of Buganda started, and so a committee was created to devise means on how the Kingdom would be managed.
Website: https://nkuluzetrust.or.ug/

lg.title: Nkuluze
lg.text:
Nkuluze emanyiddwa nga “Eggwanika ly'Obwakabaka” evunaanyizibwa okulabirira Obwakabaka (Obwakabaka bwa Kabaka). Kitongole kinene ennyo mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda, ekikulemberwa Omuwanika ow'Obwakabaka, “Omuwanika w’Enkuluze”. Omuwanika oba “Omuwanika w’Enkuluze” alondebwa mu ofiisi eno Ssaabasajja Kabaka era abeera wa buvunaanyizibwa eri ye yekka. Oluvannyuma lw'obuzibu bwa 1966 mu Buganda, kumpi enteekateeka zonna, emirimu n'ofiisi byaggalwawo lwa mpaka obufuzi obwaliwo, omwali ne Nkuluze, kubanga Kabaka yali takyali ku Nnamulondo. Kyokka oluvannyuma lw'olutalo olw'okununula eggwanga olwa 1986, enteekateeka ez'okuzzaawo Obwakabaka bwa Buganda zaatandika, era ne wassibwawo akakiiko okulowooza ku ngeri Obwakabaka gye bwandiddukanyiziddwamu.

en.title: Muteesa I Royal University
en.text:
The establishment of Muteesa I Royal University (MRU) was both inspired and motivated by Ssabasajja Kabaka Muwenda Mutebi II, with strong support from the Executive Committee of the Buganda Kingdom, led by the Katikkiro. The foundational groundwork was undertaken by the Buganda University Task Force (BUTF), which was inaugurated by the Katikkiro on 8th June 2004 and submitted its final report on 2nd December 2004. Muteesa I Royal University is a chartered university named in honour of Kabaka Muteesa I of Buganda (1856–1884), a visionary monarch whose invitation to Christian missionaries—expressed in a letter to Queen Victoria of England—is widely regarded as the genesis of modern formal education in Uganda.
Website: https://mru.ac.ug/

lg.title: Muteesa I Royal University
lg.text:
Okutandikibwawo kwa Muteesa I Royal University (MRU) kwaleetebwa era kwazzibwamu amaanyi Ssaabasajja Kabaka Muwenda Mutebi II, nga awagirwa nnyo Olukiiko Olukulu olw'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda olukulemberwa Katikkiro. Omusingi gwateekebwawo Akakiiko akaali kategeka Yunivasite ya Buganda (Buganda University Task Force – BUTF), akaatongozebwa Katikkiro nga 8 Juuni 2004 era ne kawaayo alipoota yaako esembayo nga 2 Desemba 2004. Muteesa I Royal University yunivasite erina ebbaluwa y'obuyinza (charter), etuumiddwa erinnya lya Kabaka Muteesa I owa Buganda (1856–1884), kabaka eyalina okulengera ewala, eyayita abaminsane Abakristaayo — nga yayita mu bbaluwa gye yawandiikira Nnaabakyala Victoria owa Bungereza — ekitwalibwa nnyo ng'entandikwa y'ebyenjigiriza eby'omulembe mu Uganda.
Omukutu: https://mru.ac.ug/

en.title: Lubiri High School
en.text:
Lubiri High School opened on 8th February 1999 by the Ministry of Education and Sports Buganda Government Mengo. This was as a result of the need to provide educational services to the people of Buganda and Uganda as a whole. It is located in the Kabaka’s Palace in Mengo. Lubiri High School aims at developing a holistic child through various activities which include sports, technology innovations, entrepreneurship innovations, music, dance and drama. Additionally, the children are involved in community work. They embrace charity programmes within and outside the school. They have continued to visit the sick and shared with the needy spiritually, financially and materially. These activities are redefining the school to change their approaches in order to meet the demands of the 21st century.
Website: https://lubirihighschoolmengo.ac.ug/

lg.title: Lubiri High School
lg.text:
Lubiri High School yaggulwawo nga 8 Febwali 1999 Minisitule y'Ebyenjigiriza n'Emizannyo eya Gavumenti ya Buganda e Mengo. Kino kyava ku bwetaavu bw'okuwa obuweereza bw'ebyenjigiriza eri abantu ba Buganda ne Uganda yonna okutwalira awamu. Esangibwa mu Lubiri lwa Kabaka e Mengo. Lubiri High School egenderera okukuza omwana mu ngeri ey'enjuyi zonna nga eyita mu mirimu egy'enjawulo omuli emizannyo, obuyiiya mu tekinologiya, obuyiiya mu bwannannyini bw'emirimu, ennyimba, amazina n'emizannyo gy'oku siteegi. Ate era abaana benyigira mu mirimu gy'okuyamba ebitundu. Bakkiririza mu nteekateeka z'okuyamba abali mu bwetaavu munda n'ebweru w'essomero. Beeyongedde okukyalira abalwadde n'okugabana n'abali mu bwetaavu mu by'omwoyo, mu nsimbi ne mu bintu. Emirimu gino gikyusa essomero okukyusa enkola zaalyo okutuukiriza ebyetaago by'ekyasa ekya 21.

en.title: Lubiri Nabagereka Primary School
en.text:
Lubiri Nabagereka Nursery and Primary School located inside the Kabaka’s Mengo Palace, with a beautiful evergreen compound which offers a wonderful spacious environment for both academic and co-curricular activities. Nabagereka a Buganda Kingdom owned school was established in the mid-forties to provide basic education to the young children within the palace and its environs under the patronage of Her Royal Highness the Nabagereka as a symbol of her motherly and caring role to the kingdom children. The School was vanquished in the 1966 political crisis when military troops attacked and dethroned Sir Edward Muteesa II.
Website: https://lubirinabagerekaps.com/

lg.title: Lubiri Nabagereka Primary School
lg.text:
Lubiri Nabagereka Nursery and Primary School esangibwa munda mu Lubiri lwa Kabaka e Mengo, nga erina oluggya olulungi olubeera olwa kiragala ebbanga lyonna, oluwa ekifo ekigazi ennyo ku lw'emisomo n'emirimu emirala egy'okuyiga. Nabagereka, essomero ery'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda, lyatandikibwawo wakati mu myaka gya 1940 okuwa ebyenjigiriza ebisookerwako eri abaana abato abaali mu lubiri n'okwetooloola, wansi w'obulabirizi bwa Nnaabagereka, ng'akabonero k'omulimu gwe ogw'obuzadde n'okulabirira abaana b'obwakabaka. Essomero lyasaanyizibwawo mu buzibu bw'ebyobufuzi obwa 1966, amagye bwe gaalumba ne gagoba Sir Edward Muteesa II ku ntebe.
Omukutu: https://lubirinabagerekaps.com/

en.title: Buganda Royal Institute of Business and Technical Education (BRIBTE) Mengo
en.text:
Buganda Royal Institute of Business and Technical Education (BRIBTE) Mengo was founded by Buganda Kingdom in 1999 with a view to equip students with practical knowledge and skills for employability. The Institute operates under the Ministry of Education, Buganda Kingdom and is registered with the Ministry of Education and Sports (MoES), Central Government. The Institute registration number is PCS/B/144. BRIBTE is also licensed by the National Council for Higher Education (NCHE) to offer training in Business, Technical and Vocational Studies at both Certificate and Diploma levels. In addition, the Institute is recognised by the National Examinations Bodies and was awarded examinations centers from the Uganda Business and Technical Examinations Board (UBTEB), and the Directorate of Industrial Training (DIT).
Website: https://bribte.ac.ug/

lg.title: Buganda Royal Institute of Business and Technical Education (BRIBTE) Mengo
lg.text:
Buganda Royal Institute of Business and Technical Education (BRIBTE) Mengo yatandikibwawo Obwakabaka bwa Buganda mu 1999 n'ekigendererwa ky'okuwa abayizi okumanya n'obukugu obw'enkola obubasobozesa okufuna emirimu. Ettendekero lino likola wansi wa Minisitule y'Ebyenjigiriza ey'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda era liwandiisiddwa mu Minisitule y'Ebyenjigiriza n'Emizannyo (MoES) eya Gavumenti Eya Wakati. Ennamba y'okuwandiisibwa kw'Ettendekero ye PCS/B/144. BRIBTE era erina olukusa okuva mu National Council for Higher Education (NCHE) okutendeka mu Bya Bizinensi, eby'Ekikugu n'eby'Emikono ku mitendera gya Satifikeeti ne Dipulooma. Ng'oggyeeko ekyo, Ettendekero limanyiddwa Ebitongole by'Ebigezo eby'Eggwanga era lyaweebwa ebifo by'ebigezo okuva mu Uganda Business and Technical Examinations Board (UBTEB) ne Directorate of Industrial Training (DIT).
Omukutu: https://bribte.ac.ug/

en.title: Namulondo Investments Limited
en.text:
Located in the heart of Buganda Kingdom, NIL is a property management and Real Estate Development Company incorporated under the Laws of Uganda Cap 110. It is under the stewardship of the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development. It is specifically set up to manage the Kingdom’s large portfolio of properties nestled in the country side of Buganda Kingdom as well as engage in Real Estate Development and Investment. Namulondo Investments limited also provides a range of property related services for the Kabaka’s subjects irrespective of location to help them maximize return on their investment.
Mission: To professionally manage Kingdom properties and engage in real estate investment and development while all the time ensuring customer satisfaction.
Vision: To be a premier property management and real estate development company in Buganda Kingdom, Uganda, and indeed East Africa.
Website: https://www.namulondoinvestments.co.ug/

lg.title: Namulondo Investments Limited
lg.text:
Nga esangibwa wakati mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda, NIL kampuni eddukanya ebizimbe n'ettaka era ekola ku nkulaakulana y'amayumba n'ettaka, eyawandiisibwa wansi w'Amateeka ga Uganda Cap 110. Eri wansi w'obulabirizi bwa Minisita w'Ebyensimbi, Enteekateeka n'Enkulaakulana y'Eby'enfuna. Yatandikibwawo okusingira ddala okuddukanya ebizimbe n'ettaka by'Obwakabaka ebingi ebiri mu byalo bya Buganda, n'okwenyigira mu Nkulaakulana n'Okusiga Ensimbi mu Mayumba n'Ettaka. Namulondo Investments Limited era ewa obuweereza obw'enjawulo obukwata ku bizimbe n'ettaka eri abantu ba Kabaka, k'abe nga bali wa wonna, okubayamba okufuna amagoba amangi ku nsimbi ze basiga.
Ekigendererwa: Okuddukanya ebizimbe n'ettaka by'Obwakabaka mu ngeri ey'obukugu n'okwenyigira mu kusiga ensimbi n'enkulaakulana mu mayumba n'ettaka, nga bulijjo kakasa nti bakasitoma bamatira.
Ekirooto: Okubeera kampuni esinga mu kuddukanya ebizimbe n'ettaka n'okukulaakulanya amayumba n'ettaka mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda, mu Uganda, era ne mu Buvanjuba bwa Afirika.
Omukutu: https://www.namulondoinvestments.co.ug/

en.title: Majestic Brands Limited
en.text:
Majestic Brands Limited [MBL] is a limited liability company created by Buganda Kingdom to undertake innovative and competitive activities, to harness the Buganda Brand for the benefit of the people of Buganda. MBL is a subsidiary of Buganda Investments & Commercial Undertakings (BICUL), the Kingdom’s holding company that was formed to generate revenue from engagement in viable and appropriate investment opportunities for the financing or co-financing of Buganda’s economic, social and cultural programs.
Mission: Facilitating economic empowerment for self-sustainable development.
Vision: To build a Kingdom that serves its people.

lg.title: Majestic Brands Limited

MBL kampuni ekola wansi wa Buganda Investments & Commercial Undertakings (BICUL), ekitongole ky'Obwakabaka ekirina emigabo, ekyatandikibwawo okufuna ensimbi nga kiyita mu kwenyigira mu mikisa gy'okusiga ensimbi egy'omuganyulo era egisaanidde, okuwa ensimbi oba okugattako ku nsimbi z'enteekateeka za Buganda ez'eby'enfuna, embeera z'abantu, n'obuwangwa.

en.title: Buganda Cultural & Dev’t Foundation
en.text:
The Buganda kingdom established BUCADEF in 1994 as a Non-Governmental Organisation (No. S5914/1 432), non political legitimate body corporate particularly charged with spearheading and directing social economic development in communities. It was established to achieve sustainable improvement in the living standards and welfare of the people, in addition building capacities of communities in order to render effective services to cause sustainable development. BUCADEF has various programmes which have been defined and paraded within the overall framework of existing government macro-economic policies and programmes that include;
- Economic programmes designed to create and expand income earning opportunities, specifically sustainable agriculture and enterprise development, investment and commercial undertakings.
- Social sector programmes designed to promote community development, food sufficiency, health and education services, water and sanitation and communal infrastructure.
- Social assistance programmes intended to assist disadvantaged social groups.
- Production support programmes that support the implementation of the above economic, social and social assistance programmes.
It is against this background that BUCADEF orients itself to spearhead and direct general community development emphasizing the promotion of standards of living particularly of the rural community and the urban poor in the central region
Mission: To promote and foster social economic advancement of all Buganda through blending culture with modern management styles to cause sustainable development.
Vision: A dignified quality of life for the people of Buganda.
Website: https://bucadef.org.ug/

lg.title: Buganda Cultural & Dev’t Foundation
lg.text:
Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwatandikawo BUCADEF mu 1994 ng'Ekitongole Ekitali kya Gavumenti (No. S5914/1 432), ekitali kya byabufuzi, ekiri mu mateeka, ekirina obuvunaanyizibwa obw'enjawulo okukulembera n'okulung'amya enkulaakulana y'embeera z'abantu n'eby'enfuna mu bitundu. Kyatandikibwawo okutuuka ku kulongooka okw'olubeerera mu mbeera z'obulamu n'obulungi bw'abantu, ate n'okuzimba obusobozi bw'ebitundu okuwa obuweereza obw'omugaso okuleeta enkulaakulana ey'olubeerera. BUCADEF erina enteekateeka ez'enjawulo ezitegekeddwa mu nkola y'awamu ey'enkola ne nteekateeka za gavumenti ez'eby'enfuna eziriwo, omuli;
- Enteekateeka z'eby'enfuna ezitegekeddwa okutondawo n'okugaziya emikisa gy'okufuna ensimbi, naddala ebyobulimi eby'olubeerera n'enkulaakulana y'emirimu, okusiga ensimbi n'emirimu gy'obusuubuzi.
- Enteekateeka z'embeera z'abantu ezitegekeddwa okutumbula enkulaakulana y'ebitundu, okubeera n'emmere emala, obuweereza bw'ebyobulamu n'ebyenjigiriza, amazzi n'obuyonjo, n'ebizimbe eby'awamu.
- Enteekateeka z'okuyamba ezigendereddwamu okuyamba ebibinja by'abantu ebiri mu bwetaavu.
- Enteekateeka z'okuwagira ebikolebwa eziwagira okuteeka mu nkola enteekateeka ez'eby'enfuna, embeera z'abantu, n'okuyamba ezoogeddwako waggulu.
Kino kye kiviirako BUCADEF okwetegeka okukulembera n'okulung'amya enkulaakulana y'ebitundu okutwalira awamu, ng'essira liri ku kutumbula embeera z'obulamu, naddala ez'abantu ab'omu byalo n'abaavu ab'omu bibuga mu kitundu eky'amasekkati
Ekigendererwa: Okutumbula n'okukuza enkulaakulana y'embeera z'abantu n'eby'enfuna eri Buganda yonna nga tugatta obuwangwa n'enkola ez'omulembe ez'okuddukanya emirimu okuleeta enkulaakulana ey'olubeerera.
Ekirooto: Obulamu obw'ekitiibwa era obw'omutindo eri abantu ba Buganda.
Omukutu: https://bucadef.org.ug/

en.title: Buganda Broadcasting Service
en.text:
BBS is a private limited company incorporated in February 2018 based in Kampala Uganda. Buganda Broadcasting Service is the official Broadcasting Television of the Buganda Kingdom mandated to create and engender informative, educative, entertaining and cultural content across all genres of customers through our different platforms while keeping in mind the changing needs and trends in the industry.
Our ability to provide rich content in multiple genres ranging from children’s and educational programmes, drama, announcements, news and current affairs, continue to position BBS as a trusted broadcasting media in Uganda. BBS strives to serve the information, educational and entertainment needs of millions of citizens who rely on our services for access to accurate, reliable and balanced content of each and everyone’s choice.
Website: https://www.bbstv.ug/

lg.title: Buganda Broadcasting Service
lg.text:
BBS kampuni ey'obwannannyini erina obuvunaanyizibwa obukomye, eyawandiisibwa mu Febwali 2018 nga esangibwa mu Kampala, Uganda. Buganda Broadcasting Service ye Ttivvi entongole ey'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda, erina obuvunaanyizibwa okukola n'okuleeta ebiweerezebwa ebimanyisa, ebisomesa, ebisanyusa, n'eby'obuwangwa mu bika byonna eri bakasitoma ab'enjawulo nga eyita ku mikutu gyaffe egy'enjawulo, nga bwe tulowooza ku byetaago n'enkyukakyuka ebikyuka mu by'amawulire.
Obusobozi bwaffe okuwa ebiweerezebwa ebingi mu bika eby'enjawulo, okuva ku pulogulaamu z'abaana n'ez'okusomesa, emizannyo, ebirango, amawulire n'ensonga eziriwo, bikyeyongera okuteeka BBS mu kifo ky'omukutu gw'amawulire ogwesigika mu Uganda. en.text:

Buganda in Kampala has been referred to as the home of one of the world’s richest cultural sites. The trail covers a radius of about 25 Kilometers. These include heritage sites, eco-tourism, Galleries, craft shops, bookshops, entertainment points and lifestyle among the Baganda people too interesting.
Website: https://www.bugandatourism.com/

lg.title: Buganda Heritage & Tourism Board

Mulimu ebifo eby'obusika, obulambuzi bw'obutonde, ebifo eby'okwolesezaamu (galleries), amaduuka g'ebintu eby'emikono, amaduuka g'ebitabo, ebifo eby'okwesanyusaamu, n'obulamu bw'Abaganda obunyuvu ennyo.

en.title: PEWOSA
en.text:

It is envisioned that this will bring about improved quality of life for the people of Buganda and Uganda at large.

Kisuubirwa nti kino kijja kuleeta okulongooka kw'obulamu bw'abantu ba Buganda ne Uganda yonna okutwalira awamu.

en.title: Buganda Kingdom and UNICEF formalise partnership to promote the rights and future of 4.2 million children
en.text:
2025-12-01
KAMPALA, UGANDA – 13 November 2025 – The Kingdom of Buganda, through the Buganda Investment and Commercial Undertaking Ltd. (BICUL) and the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF), today signed, at the Buganda Parliament, a pivotal Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to launch a comprehensive partnership dedicated to improving the well-being and fulfilment of rights of the 4.2 million children in the Buganda region.
This collaboration is founded on the conviction that every child deserves to survive, to thrive, and to fulfill their potential. By blending resources with the Kingdom’s deep community roots and cultural authority and UNICEF’s authoritative global technical expertise the partnership is designed to generate sustainable, forward-looking positive change for children.
The spirit of the partnership is intrinsically linked to the traditional Buganda concept of Bulungi Bwansi—working for the common good—reflecting the core principles of the Convention on the Rights of the Child.
At today’s signing event, the Katikkiro of Buganda, Owek. Charles Mayiga highlighted the impact of the collaboration: “The way a community takes care of its children is how its future can be determined. A child is the foundation of adulthood, and we see our responsibility as absolute. We value this collaboration with UNICEF immensely because it enables us to comprehensively ensure child’s health and nutrition, keep children in school, and protect them from violence. Working together allows us to immediately extend our efforts across education, immunization, nutrition, and health, securing the well-being of the next generation of Buganda.”
The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) establishes four interconnected commitments where joint efforts will focus on issues impacting children and their rights, including on:
- Child survival: Scale up immunization and use Kingdom media to share life-saving information to reduce preventable mortality and malnutrition.
- Quality education: Eliminate barriers for vulnerable children. Focus on Early Childhood Development, launch re-enrolment campaigns, and empower Kabaka Youth Councils.
- Child protection: End abuse, violence, child marriage, and adolescent pregnancies. Strengthen birth registration systems and collaborate with traditional leaders.
- Behaviour change and uplifting children’s voices: Shift attitudes by providing platforms for children to advocate for their own rights, recognizing them as agents of change, and fighting harmful social practices.
The UNICEF representative, Dr Robin Nandy, noted the urgency and vision of the agreement: “This Memorandum of Understanding is a promise to the children of the Buganda Kingdom and Uganda. We will be a reliable, transparent, and respectful partner, ensuring every resource invested translates into tangible improvements. Together in making a difference for the children, we are greater than the sum of our parts.“
A Joint Steering Committee will be established to define an action plan to implement the commitments taken through the Memorandum of Understanding, monitor progress of activities run and document successful models that can be further scaled up and shared.

lg.title: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ne UNICEF Bakkiriziganya ku Mukago Ogutumbula Eddembe n'Ebiseera eby'Omu Maaso eby'Abaana Obukadde 4.2
lg.text:
2025-12-01
KAMPALA, UGANDA – 13 Novemba 2025 – Obwakabaka bwa Buganda, nga buyita mu Buganda Investment and Commercial Undertaking Ltd. (BICUL), ne United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF), leero bassizza omukono, mu Lukiiko lwa Buganda, ku Ndagaano y'Okukwatagana (MoU) ey'enkizo okutandikawo omukago omugazi ogwewaddeyo okulongoosa embeera n'okutuukiriza eddembe ly'abaana obukadde 4.2 mu kitundu kya Buganda.
Omukago guno gwesigamye ku kukkiriza nti buli mwana agwanidde okuwangaala, okukula obulungi, n'okutuukiriza obusobozi bwe bwonna. Nga tugatta eby'obugagga n'emirandira egy'amaanyi Obwakabaka gye bulina mu bantu n'obuyinza bwabwo mu buwangwa, awamu n'obukugu bwa UNICEF obw'ensi yonna, omukago guno gutegekeddwa okuleeta enkyukakyuka ennungi ey'olubeerera era etunuulira eby'omu maaso eri abaana.
Omwoyo gw'omukago guno gukwatagana nnyo n'endowooza ya Buganda ey'ennono eya Bulungi Bwansi — okukolera awamu ku lw'obulungi bwa bonna — era guyoleka emisingi emikulu egy'Endagaano y'Eddembe ly'Omwana.
Ku mukolo gw'okussa omukono ogwabadde leero, Katikkiro wa Buganda, Owek. Charles Mayiga, yalaze omugaso gw'omukago guno: “Engeri ekitundu gye kirabiriramu abaana baakyo ye nsalawo y'ebiseera byakyo eby'omu maaso. Omwana gwe musingi gw'obukulu, era obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe tubutwala nga bwa nkomeredde. Omukago guno ne UNICEF tugutwala nga gwa muwendo nnyo kubanga gutusobozesa okukakasa mu bujjuvu obulamu n'endya ennungi ey'abaana, okukuuma abaana mu masomero, n'okubakuuma eri obutabanguko. Okukolera awamu kutusobozesa okugaziya amangu kaweefube waffe mu byenjigiriza, okugema endwadde, endya ennungi, n'ebyobulamu, nga tukakasa obulungi bw'omulembe ogujja ogwa Buganda.”
Endagaano y'Okukwatagana (MoU) essaawo obweyamo buna obukwatagana, kaweefube ow'awamu mw'agenda okussa essira ku nsonga ezikwata ku baana n'eddembe lyabwe, omuli:
- Okuwonya obulamu bw'abaana: Okwongera ku kugema endwadde n'okukozesa emikutu gy'amawulire gy'Obwakabaka okugabana amawulire agawonya obulamu okukendeeza ku kufa okuyinza okwewalibwa n'endya embi.
- Ebyenjigiriza eby'omutindo: Okumalawo ebiziyiza eri abaana abali mu bwetaavu. Okussa essira ku Nkulaakulana y'Abaana Abato, okutandika kaweefube w'okuzza abaana mu masomero, n'okuwa amaanyi Enkiiko z'Abavubuka za Kabaka.
- Okukuuma abaana: Okumalawo okutulugunyizibwa, obutabanguko, obufumbo bw'abaana abato, n'embuto mu bawala abato. Okunyweza enkola z'okuwandiisa abazaalibwa n'okukolagana n'abakulembeze b'ennono.
- Enkyukakyuka mu nneeyisa n'okusitula amaloboozi g'abaana: Okukyusa endowooza nga tuwa abaana emikutu okwogerera eddembe lyabwe, nga tubakkiriza ng'abaleeta enkyukakyuka, n'okulwanyisa empisa ez'obulabe mu bantu.
Omubaka wa UNICEF, Dr Robin Nandy, yalaze obwangu n'okulengera ewala okw'endagaano eno: “Endagaano eno y'Okukwatagana kisuubizo eri abaana b'Obwakabaka bwa Buganda ne Uganda. Tujja kubeera munnamukago omwesigwa, omutangaavu, era ow'ekitiibwa, nga tukakasa nti buli ssente esigiddwa evaamu okulongooka okulabika. Nga tuli wamu mu kuleeta enjawulo eri abaana, tuli ba maanyi okusinga ffe kinnoomu.“
Wajja kussibwawo Akakiiko k'Awamu Akalung'amya okutegeka enteekateeka y'emirimu okuteeka mu nkola obweyamo obwakolebwa mu Ndagaano y'Okukwatagana, okulondoola enkulaakulana y'emirimu egikolebwa, n'okuwandiika enkola ezitambudde obulungi eziyinza okugaziyizibwa n'okugabanwa.

en.title: Buganda Kingdom Signs MoU with EACOP to Advance Environmental Conservation and Community Development

This strategic partnership focuses on two key initiatives:
- 🌳 Advancing tree growing under Ekibira Kya Kabaka
- 🏟️ Constructing a modern community sports center in Buddu County, Masaka District
As part of this collaboration, the Kingdom has committed 120 acres of land to support tree growing under the Ekibira Kya Kabaka initiative, and an additional 10 acres for the development of a state-of-the-art sports center. EACOP will provide financial support for the facility, which will serve as a hub for nurturing talent, promoting fitness, and empowering youth through community engagement.
The signing ceremony was held at Bulange Mengo, where our Katikkiro, Owek. Charles Peter Mayiga, emphasized the importance of partnerships that address pressing challenges such as climate change, environmental conservation, and youth empowerment. He stated:
“The Kingdom cherishes partnerships that address urgent challenges such as climate change, environmental conservation, and youth empowerment. Through Ekibira Kya Kabaka and the new community sports center, we are creating a legacy of resilience, opportunity, and growth for our people.”
EACOP’s Managing Director, Mr. Guillaume DULOUT, reaffirmed their commitment to sustainability and socio-economic development, noting:
We were honored by the presence of Hon. Ruth Nankabirwa, Minister of Energy and Mineral Development, who commended both parties for forging a partnership that strengthens environmental conservation and community development.
This collaboration aligns with EACOP’s Social Economic Investment pillars, which prioritize environmental protection and youth empowerment. It also acknowledges the central role of Buganda Kingdom in the pipeline’s journey, with 7 of the 10 pipeline districts located within our territory, covering over 130 villages across four counties.
The Kingdom of Buganda remains steadfast in its commitment to initiatives that uplift our people, protect our environment, and build a resilient future for generations to come.

lg.title: Obwakabaka bwa Buganda Bussa Omukono ku MoU ne EACOP Okutumbula Okukuuma Obutonde bw'Ensi n'Enkulaakulana y'Ebitundu
lg.text:
2025-09-25
Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bwenyumiriza okulangirira okussa omukono ku Ndagaano y'Okukwatagana (MoU) ne East African Crude Oil Pipeline (EACOP) Ltd., egendereddwamu okunyweza enkolagana mu kukuuma obutonde bw'ensi n'enkulaakulana y'ebitundu.
Omukago guno ogw'enkizo gussa essira ku nteekateeka bbiri enkulu:
- Okutumbula okusimba emiti wansi wa Ekibira Kya Kabaka
- Okuzimba ekifo ky'emizannyo eky'omulembe eky'abantu mu Ssaza Buddu, Disitulikiti y'e Masaka
Ng'ekitundu ku nkolagana eno, Obwakabaka buwaddeyo yiika z'ettaka 120 okuwagira okusimba emiti wansi wa kaweefube wa Ekibira Kya Kabaka, n'endala yiika 10 ez'okuzimbako ekifo ky'emizannyo eky'omulembe. EACOP ejja kuwaayo obuyambi bw'ensimbi ku kifo kino, ekijja okubeera ekifo eky'okukuza ebitone, okutumbula obulamu bw'omubiri, n'okuwa abavubuka amaanyi nga beenyigira mu mirimu gy'ebitundu.
Omukolo gw'okussa omukono gwabadde mu Bulange Mengo, Katikkiro waffe, Owek. Charles Peter Mayiga, gye yakkaatirizza obukulu bw'emikago egikola ku bizibu ebinyigiriza nga enkyukakyuka y'obudde, okukuuma obutonde bw'ensi, n'okuwa abavubuka amaanyi. Yagambye nti:
“Obwakabaka butwala nga bya muwendo emikago egikola ku bizibu eby'amangu nga enkyukakyuka y'obudde, okukuuma obutonde bw'ensi, n'okuwa abavubuka amaanyi. Nga tuyita mu Kibira Kya Kabaka n'ekifo ky'emizannyo ekipya eky'abantu, tutondawo obusika bw'okugumira embeera, emikisa, n'enkulaakulana eri abantu baffe.”
Ssenkulu wa EACOP, Mw. Guillaume DULOUT, yazzeemu okukakasa obweyamo bwabwe eri okuwangaala kw'obutonde n'enkulaakulana y'embeera z'abantu n'eby'enfuna, ng'agamba nti:
Twafunye ekitiibwa olw'okubeerawo kwa Hon. Ruth Nankabirwa, Minisita w'Amasannyalaze n'Eby'obugagga eby'omu Ttaka, eyasiimye enjuyi zombi olw'okukola omukago ogunyweza okukuuma obutonde bw'ensi n'enkulaakulana y'ebitundu.
Enkolagana eno ekwatagana n'empagi za EACOP ez'Okusiga Ensimbi mu Mbeera z'Abantu n'Eby'enfuna, ezissa essira ku kukuuma obutonde bw'ensi n'okuwa abavubuka amaanyi. Era ekkiriza omulimu omukulu Obwakabaka bwa Buganda gwe bukola mu lugendo lw'omudumu guno, kubanga disitulikiti 7 ku 10 omudumu mwe guyita ziri mu kitundu kyaffe, nga zitwaliramu ebyalo ebisoba mu 130 mu masaza ana.
Obwakabaka bwa Buganda bunywerera mu bweyamo bwabwo eri enteekateeka ezisitula abantu baffe, ezikuuma obutonde bwaffe, era ezizimba ebiseera eby'omu maaso ebigumu eri emirembe egijja.

Omukago guno ogw'awamu gujja kuwa omukutu ogw'okukolagana okutendeka, okuwa obukugu, okutumbula, okuzza engulu n'okuwagira abantu ba Buganda abaakosebwa endwadde z'omutima n'emisuwa n'okusannyalala, n'okuwagira abantu bangi nga bwe kisoboka. Enkolagana eno ejja kwongera ku busobozi bw'abasawo abasookerwako mu malwaliro okuzzaamu abalwadde omukka (resuscitation), n'okuwagira enteekateeka z'okwogerera n'okunoonyereza ku ndwadde z'omutima mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda ne Uganda yonna okutwalira awamu.
Minisita w'Obuweereza bw'Abantu mu Bwakabaka bwa Buganda ng'assa omukono ku Ndagaano y'Okukwatagana n'Akulira Health Heart Foundation

en.title: Affordable houses in Sentema Estate: Buganda Kingdom partners with Centenary Bank
en.text:
2021-02-03
Buganda Kingdom signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Centenary Rural Development bank on 3rd February 2021, to enable the people acquire affordable housing units in Mirembe estate in Sentema through mortgage financing. Sentema is located only 13 kms from the Kampala Northern By-Pass.
The MoU will see the development of 400 housing units comprising of one to three bedrooms on 50 acres, a vocational school on 10 acres, an industrial park on 50 acres as well as restaurants, shopping mall, clinic and other recreational sites.
Below are the house types and costs;
- Single bedroom house – UgShs58M
- Two bedroom – UgShs95M
- Three bedroom – UgShs130M
Housing Finance Bank will offer mortgage loans with very low interest rate for a period of 10 years to all those who desire to acquire the houses.

en.title: Buganda Kingdom signed a MOU with Ministry of Water and Environment (MWE)
en.text:
2018-09-26
Buganda Kingdom signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Ministry of Water and Environment (MWE) on 15th September, 2021 to provide a platform for collaboration and co-operation between the Kingdom of Buganda and Ministry of Water and Environment to foster and advocate for the conservation of water, environment and natural resources.
The joint partnership will see the provision of a collaborative platform to establish a working relationship where the parties would jointly undertake projects/activities relating to Water, Sanitation & Hygiene (WASH) , supporting small and medium scale farmers to use technology for irrigation and livestock watering including water harvesting during the rainy seasons, sustainable utilization of natural resources, and, sensitization on water and environmental protection and conservation.
